title: ムーンライトシンドローム
sources: Relative search of the disc files found no plain script: it is most likely compressed on disc
notes: Own 16-bit codes (Human's scheme, shared with Twilight Syndrome): kana in a fixed order below 0x0100, kanji from 0x0100 in font order, 0xFFF0-0xFFFF control codes. Byte order, the kana order and control meanings still to be mapped, from a memory sample or the game font.
